We are an amazing sanctuary for feral cats! We are located in Faribault, Minnesota. 

The cats that live here are cats that had to be live trapped as they were completely un-socialized to humans.  

Regular rescues and shelters cannot take in these cats as it can take years for them to be come adoptable.  We have a full time Veterinarian on site for these lucky formerly homeless cats.

Over time, some of these cats gradually learn to trust and love humans and we can adopt them out!  If they don't ever learn to like humans, that is where the word "sanctuary" is important.  They can live out their lives with us.  No threat for euthanasia for lack of space or for being with us too long.  

Please watch our videos and you will see how this truly is a heaven on earth for these cats who lived a life of struggles before coming to us.  Thank you! 😻😻
